attempts.summary: Created OpenRC-managed service "inventory-worker" on node1 that runs a long-running shell loop confined via bubblewrap: root filesystem read-only, /var/lib/inventory the only writable bind mount, running as unprivileged uid 1001 (dedicated "inventory" user), with NoNewPrivs=1 enforced (bwrap default, verified). Service enabled in the default runlevel. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id/boot time/service+data health, issued a native reboot whose ack returned before disconnection, polled through the outage, confirmed a new boot_id/boot time post-restart, and verified the service auto-started and resumed writing inventory snapshots.
